notes.title: New Build 9/2/2016
notes.content:
Hey, guys!

 I just wanted to let you know that I'm uploading a build right now to fix a minor walking bug. We have plans to be updating the game all tonight and throughout the rest of the weekend, so if there's any cool things you want to see in the game or if you encounter a bug you want fixed asap, then just post a comment or direct message us; we'll be here to handle it. :-)

 C3 Games
